All scripts are ready and executable. Here's what you have:

README.md              - Main overview and script inventory

MASTER SCRIPTS (Run These)
---------------------------
build-test-library.sh  - Main orchestrator - RUN THIS FIRST
                         Generates complete test library with both hierarchies
                         Usage: ./build-test-library.sh [--clean] [--issue-only]

build-by-issue-hierarchy.sh - Builds by_issue/ hierarchy
                              Runs all issue generators

create-media-library.sh     - Builds category hierarchy (lib1/lib2/lib3/by_codec)
                              Tests filesystem organization

BUILDING BLOCKS (Layer 1 - Primitives)
---------------------------------------
generate-video.sh      - Generate videos with specific codecs
                         Supports H.264, H.265, VP9, AV1, etc.
                         Usage: ./generate-video.sh "text" 20 output.mp4 [options]

generate-audio.sh      - Generate audio with various formats
                         Supports AAC, AC3, DTS, Opus, MP3, etc.
                         Usage: ./generate-audio.sh 20 output.ac3 [options]

generate-subtitle.sh   - Generate SRT subtitle files
                         Usage: ./generate-subtitle.sh 20 "text" output.srt

CONTAINER MUXER (Layer 2)
--------------------------
mux-container.sh       - Combine video/audio/subtitle streams
                         Supports MKV, MP4, AVI, MOV, WebM
                         Multi-audio and multi-subtitle support
                         Usage: ./mux-container.sh --video v.mp4 --audio a.aac --output out.mkv

ISSUE GENERATORS (Layer 3 - Domain Specific)
---------------------------------------------
generate-codec-variations.sh       - 11 codec combination test cases
                                     Tests: H.264, H.265, VP9, AV1, DivX, XviD, MPEG2
                                     + various audio codecs

generate-audio-tracks.sh           - 6 multi-audio test cases
                                     Tests: Dual language, stereo, 5.1, 7.1
                                     Mixed codecs, no audio

generate-subtitle-variations.sh    - 7 subtitle test cases
                                     Tests: External, embedded, multi-language
                                     Hebrew encoding, forced subtitles

generate-resolution-variations.sh  - 16 resolution test cases
                                     Tests: 480p-4K, DVD PAL/NTSC, portrait
                                     Ultra-wide, wrong metadata

generate-broken-files.sh           - 10 broken file test cases
                                     Tests: Truncated, zero-byte, corrupted
                                     Wrong extensions, special characters

generate-metadata-issues.sh        - 10 metadata test cases
                                     Tests: VFR, 23.976fps, interlaced
                                     Color spaces, pixel formats, HDR

QUICK START COMMANDS
--------------------
# Make all scripts executable
chmod +x *.sh

# Generate complete test library (10-30 minutes)
./build-test-library.sh

# Generate only edge cases (faster)
./build-test-library.sh --issue-only

# Generate to custom location
./build-test-library.sh /path/to/output

# Clean and rebuild
./build-test-library.sh --clean

# Run individual generators
./generate-codec-variations.sh ./output
./generate-audio-tracks.sh ./output
./generate-broken-files.sh ./output

OUTPUT STRUCTURE
----------------
test-library/
├── by_issue/                    # Edge cases by problem type
│   ├── codec_variations/        # 11 codec tests
│   ├── audio_tracks/            # 6 audio tests
│   ├── subtitle_variations/     # 7 subtitle tests
│   ├── resolution_variations/   # 16 resolution tests
│   ├── broken_files/            # 10 broken file tests
│   └── metadata_issues/         # 10 metadata tests
│
├── lib1/                        # Movies (category hierarchy)
├── lib2/                        # TV Series
├── lib3/                        # Short clips
└── by_codec/                    # Codec comparison tests
    ├── h264/
    ├── h265/
    ├── vp9/
    └── av1/

WHAT YOU GET
------------
- 60+ edge case test scenarios
- 100+ video files (10-20 seconds each)
- ~500MB-2GB total size
- Complete coverage of production library issues

REQUIREMENTS
------------
Essential:
- ffmpeg (with libx264, libx265, libvpx-vp9)
- bash 4.0+

Recommended:
- libsvtav1 (for fast AV1 encoding)
- ffprobe (for metadata display)

Optional:
- tree (view structure)
- mediainfo (detailed inspection)

TESTING WORKFLOW
----------------
1. Generate test library:
   ./build-test-library.sh

2. Run your media scanner:
   my-collection scan test-library/by_issue
   my-collection scan test-library/lib1

3. Test specific scenarios:
   my-collection scan test-library/by_issue/codec_variations
   my-collection scan test-library/by_issue/broken_files
   my-collection convert test-library/by_codec/h264 --target h265

4. Fix bugs and add new test cases as needed

5. Regenerate and retest:
   ./build-test-library.sh --clean

ARCHITECTURE
------------
Layer 5: build-test-library.sh (Master Orchestrator)
           │
           ├─→ Layer 4: build-by-issue-hierarchy.sh
           │              │
           │              └─→ Layer 3: Issue Generators
           │                            (codec, audio, subtitle, etc.)
           │                            │
           │                            └─→ Layer 2: mux-container.sh
           │                                          │
           │                                          └─→ Layer 1: Primitives
           │                                                       (video, audio, subtitle)
           │
           └─→ Layer 4: create-media-library.sh
                          │
                          └─→ Layer 1: Primitives

TROUBLESHOOTING
---------------
Problem: "ffmpeg not found"
Solution: Install ffmpeg
  macOS:   brew install ffmpeg
  Ubuntu:  sudo apt install ffmpeg
  Arch:    sudo pacman -S ffmpeg

Problem: AV1 encoding too slow
Solution: Install libsvtav1 or skip AV1 tests
  Edit generate-video.sh and change av1 codec

Problem: Out of disk space
Solution: Use --issue-only or run selective generators
  ./build-test-library.sh --issue-only

Problem: Permission denied
Solution: chmod +x *.sh

CUSTOMIZATION
-------------
To add new test cases:
1. Create generate-my-test.sh following existing patterns
2. Add to build-by-issue-hierarchy.sh generators array
3. Rebuild: ./build-test-library.sh --clean

NOTES
-----
- All videos are 10-20 seconds for fast testing
- Videos optimized for speed (ultrafast presets)
- Some files are placeholders to save generation time
- Generated content is synthetic (no copyright issues)
- Built specifically for testing my-collection's edge case handling
